messages:
maya: observed an odd stall in the sampleapp streaming path when reconnects hit a 429 + Retry-After. Node + Python. Sometimes the client never emits the remainder of the event stream. anyone seen this pattern?

sam: hmm. quick q: does the reconnect include Last-Event-Id? and does the proxy sometimes replay buffered bytes after the new connection?

maya: we do set Last-Event-Id on reconnect, but there's an auth refresh path that sometimes recreates headers. repro: start long chat, force reconnect, proxy returns 429 on reconnect attempt, client waits Retry-After then opens new connection. logs: 
```
[INFO] reconnecting lastId=evt_900
[WARN] upstream -> 429 Retry-After: 2
[INFO] reconnected
DEBUG recv: "data: {\"id\":\"evt_901\",\"text\":\"Par\"\nDEBUG recv: \"tial

\"\nERROR parser: unexpected EOF waiting for event terminator
```

leah: two separate things to fix: 1) make sure header-preserve on token refresh so Last-Event-Id actually goes upstream, 2) make the SSE consumer tolerant of fragments across connection boundaries (buffer partial `data:` lines and prepend on reconnect).

sam: also add a tiny seq field server-side. If events arrive out-of-order we can detect and drop/reconcile. Proxies that buffer a TCP segment and then flush it after a reconnect can produce reorder.

maya: i noticed when the auth refresh hits mid-reconnect the node client preserved Last-Event-Id but python didn't. i'll run an A/B with auth refresh disabled.

leah: i'll open a small python SDK patch to preserve arbitrary headers on refresh; shouldn't be risky. sam, can you prototype parser buffering? keep trailing bytes between connections for a short TTL and treat `data:` fragments as continuation until `\n\n` terminator seen. also dedupe by event.id <= lastSeen.

sam: yep. i can add a unit test that simulates interleaved chunk delivery and a reconnect that returns buffered older chunk after the new stream opens. will also emit logs on seq gaps to help ops.

maya: i'll add a flaky-proxy CI job (nginx config that returns 429 once per reconnect and occasionally delays flush). i'll attach repro and test harness.

ignite-bot: created issue #1847: "sse reconnect race with 429 -> parser hang / reorder" and attached logs + nginx.conf.

leah: plan: leah -> python header preserve PR; sam -> parser+buffering PR for both SDKs; maya -> flaky CI + repro harness. target: ship fixes and run a 24h staging canary.

sam: quick implementation note: in JS parser keep a small string buffer and an in-flight event accumulator, on 'close' save tail up to 8KB and reapply on reconnect; also tolerate stray `\r` and extra newlines.

maya: thanks all. will update issue with CI job and results once ready.
